source.custom: Backgrounds: feat only, no ASI (2026-11-06 ruling).

system.description: You have working relationships throughout the criminal underworld. In most settlements you can locate fences, black market vendors, and criminal contacts capable of providing goods or information unavailable through legitimate channels. When dealing with known criminals or members of organized crime you gain advantage on Persuasion and Intimidation checks. Work with your GM to establish which organizations are friendly toward you and which are hostile.
